description: Lemma aggregation gold standard: Freq and Docs per lemma across multiple documents.
notes: Freq = total token occurrences of this lemma across all docs. Docs = count of distinct documents where lemma appears at least once. Invariant: Docs <= Freq always. Different surface forms mapping to the same lemma must be aggregated together.

expected_aggregates.notes: Appears 3x in DOC_01 + 1x in DOC_02 = freq 4; in 2 distinct docs
1x in DOC_01, 1x in DOC_02, 1x in DOC_03 = freq 3; in 3 distinct docs
1x in DOC_02, 2x in DOC_03 = freq 3; in 2 distinct docs

invariants.name: docs_lte_freq
invariants.check: all(row.docs <= row.freq for row in aggregates)

invariants.name: no_duplicate_lemma
invariants.description: Each lemma_text appears exactly once in the aggregate table
invariants.check: len(set(r.lemma for r in aggregates)) == len(aggregates)

invariants.name: total_tokens_match
invariants.description: Sum of all Freq values == total number of tokens across all documents
invariants.check: sum(r.freq for r in aggregates) == total_token_count
